feedback.pageSubtitle: A short reflection on your onboarding experience so far. Your answers help HR improve the journey for the next new staff member.
feedback.introTitle: Take a few minutes to reflect
feedback.introBody: There are no right or wrong answers. Share as much or as little as you like — honest impressions are the most useful.
feedback.expectationsLabel: Is the onboarding what you expected?
feedback.expectationsHint: For example: was it clearer or more document-heavy than you imagined?
feedback.unclearHint: Topics, steps, policies, or tools you would like more explanation about.
feedback.improvementsLabel: What would make the course better?
feedback.improvementsHint: Ideas for the next person starting at Silverleaf.
feedback.alreadySubmittedBody: Your reflection has been saved. You can update your answers any time if your thoughts change.
feedback.completionBody: Thank you — your reflection helps us keep improving the onboarding experience.
feedback.errorEmpty: Please answer at least one question before submitting.
feedback.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.
